title: 第20章 迷雾废墟的秘密第21章 梦中人
content_zh:
第二十章 迷雾废墟的秘密
魔力凝结？
罗德这可真是有些惊讶，要知道他玩召唤剑士七个年头了，什么样的诡异状况都见过，但是这么诡异的状况可是从来没有见过。
所谓魔力凝结，是指一些与持有者配合默契，长期使用的召唤精灵，在进化过程中，会“孕育”一些东西，按照游戏中的说法就是，因为它们的进化太快，导致过量的魔力在其中凝结，最终会幻化为魔力凝结物———换句话说，就是装备。
不过在玩家口中更加简便的说法就是，和自己好感度高的召唤精灵在进化之后会送给他们一份惊喜……仅此而已。
但是这并不算是什么令人羡慕的事情，一来召唤精灵给的装备等级大都不高，二来就是这些装备都是幻化产物，只供召唤者一个人使用，丢弃的话就会直接化为虚无，不能卖也不能送人，所以算是半个鸡肋。
罗德对于召唤精灵产生魔力凝结倒不惊讶，毕竟这把圣剑一直跟随自己到现在了，但让他惊讶的是———圣剑难道不应该是装备吗？
一般来说，只有拥有自我意志的生物才会拥有魔力凝结的特性啊？
这是怎么回事？
圣剑可不算是生物啊。
不过罗德的愣神也只是片刻工夫，因此这道系统提示根本就没有让他确认，只是告诉他有这么回事，仅此而已。于是那金黄色的文字很快就从罗德的眼前消散，消失不见。随后，原本漂浮在他手心中的卡片也重新归于虚无。
莉洁和梅斯对视了一眼，但是两人都什么也没有说。他们其实到现在都不是很清楚罗德究竟是什么人，也不知道他的身份。虽然他看起来象个剑士，但是除去剑术之外，他所做的一切都很难和剑士这个职业挂上钩。不过两人也都没有多问，莉洁身为一个冒险者，自然知道很多剑士都拥有自己独特的力量和传承。而梅斯则也因此更加确定罗德很有可能是某个古老家族的传人，只有他们才会拥有这种超乎寻常的存在。
虽然察觉到了他们的目光，但是罗德也没有做太多的解释，作为一个公会团长，他很清楚没必要的话少说，没必要的事少做。要知道网上那些玩家打起口水战来那叫一个精彩激烈，你一句话一个词用不对都有可能被对方大肆借题发挥，特别是在后来，罗德成就了第一公会，树大招风，他的一言一行更是不被不少敌人拿来发挥。你解释的越多漏洞就越多，干脆就什么也不说，任凭他们去误会。他只是收回卡牌，便开始整理起其他的物品。
法师都是相当有钱的。
在教堂中，莉洁和梅斯所发现的并不仅仅只有那个控制石像鬼的雕像，还有一小堆宝石以及失去了魔力的水晶，这些都被罗德留了下来。作为一个兼职的炼金术士，这些东西对于他来说还是有些用处的。
而让罗德感到有些意外的，则是莉洁在书桌上发现的一本日记，上面所记载的，正是那个法师来到这个小镇之后的生活。
这让罗德不由的产生了兴趣，虽然作为玩家，他对迷雾废墟整个副本的前因后果来龙去脉可以说是一清二楚滚瓜烂熟，但是从NPC的角度来看却还是第一次。
虽然日记本里的大部分内容已经变的模糊不清，不过却还是有一些记录残留了下来：
圣者之年，雷鸣之月五日
我成功了，在以无数无辜的性命为代价之后，我终于清楚的看见了她的影子，在法阵中央，她向我微笑，和活着时一样的，温柔的微笑。我甚至激动的无法自己，我呼唤着她的名字，但是她却并没有能够听到我的回应。法术并不完全，但是我已经有了希望，我的想法是正确的！

圣者之年，雷鸣之月十五日
赞美圣魂！我终于重新得到了她，我获得了足以抵抗万物的力量！将那消亡的灵魂重新带回到了我的身边，她看见我了！我能够触摸到她，感受她温暖的身体，她抱着我，轻声的叫着我的名字。在那一刻，我觉得自己所做的一切都是值得的。啊……我最爱的希娜，她还是和活着时一样那么温柔，那么美丽，那么体贴。
我很矛盾，但是我最终下定决心向她忏悔，我告诉她我做了什么，但是希娜原谅了我。她和以前一样，微笑着原谅了我。在那一刻，我觉得生命是如此的美好，甚至连外面的阳光，都是这么的明媚。我已经决定了，我要带着她离开这里，我们要过普通人的生活，和普通人一样的生活。我不会再接触这些邪法，也不会再使用法术，我们要搬去一个安静的山村，然后在那里结婚，生子，然后象普通人一样的死去。
我不知道我是否还有资格得到这样的幸福，但是我会努力争取，愿圣魂庇佑我吧。
圣者之年，亵渎之月三日
事情有些不对。
那不是希娜，我有这种感觉，虽然她的外表和我记忆中的完全一样，但是我却有这种感觉。那不是她，我对她说了我的计划，但是她只是微笑着，说好，说同意。这太奇怪了，她是个聪明的女孩，但也是个有主见的女孩。她不可能什么都听我的。
我有些怀疑，难道是法术当中出现了什么问题？
她为什么会对我的话如此深信不疑？
我要再做一次试验，以确认我的想法是否正确，圣魂保佑，希望我的想法是错误的。
圣者之年，亵渎之月四日
圣魂在上，为什么会出现这样的事！
那不是希娜！她只是一个有着希娜外壳的怪物！我告诉她，我会为了她去杀人，老人，小孩，女人。我不止需要她一个女人，我要更多的女人陪伴在我的身边。如果这真的是她，那么她是绝对不会同意的。但是，让我惊讶的是，她就那样安静的坐在床边，微笑着听我说完了一切，然后温柔的对我说好。
这不可能！这不是她！这不是我记忆里的那个人！她究竟是什么东西？是什么东西？是什么东西？（字迹开始变的杂乱无章）。
圣者之年，亵渎之月九日
愿圣魂原谅我的无知。
这或许就是我违背圣律的惩罚，我想要逆转生死，重新获得已经消逝的灵魂。但是我失败了，这就是惩罚。那个东西并不是希娜，它根本就没有自我，它只是一个空空的躯壳，本能的印照和探索着他人内心深处的精神影像来存活的怪物。我想要杀了它，但是我已经做不到了，它吸取了我所有的力量……我要死了，我已经没有力量阻止它了。
这样也好……希娜，既然你不能够来到我的身边，那么就让我去永恒的幽暗之河寻找你吧…………
愿圣魂能够接纳我这罪孽深重的灵魂…………
日记写到这里，剩下的只有一片空白。罗德合上日记，接着摇了摇头，看来这个法师果然如传闻中所说的，是个情圣啊……不过要是他早点选择自杀，估计也就不会死那么多人。但是…………

一丝微小的不协调感从罗德的脑中闪过，他还没有来得及抓住，就一闪而逝。
似乎有什么不对？
罗德皱着眉头，思考了半天，但是最终也没有得到答案。不过，他很快就把这件事放在脑后，闭上眼睛，很快就陷入了深沉的睡眠之中。
这只是一个小小的插曲，随后三人在这废弃的教堂中休息了一晚，第二天便再次启程，向着雾气的深处走去。
“唰！”
耀眼的白光一闪而过，随之而来的则是伴随着哀号声消逝的幽鬼的身影。
与之前相比，进化后的星痕更加美丽，洁白无暇的剑刃上雕刻着美丽精致的镂空花纹，原本合拢的雪白双翼微微展开，从中盘旋而出的白色银线化为笼手围绕在剑柄之上，单单仅是看着，就不会认为这是一把武器，而是精美的艺术品，它不应该出现在战场上，反而美术馆或者藏宝室一类的地方才是它真正的归属。
“真是无比神奇的杰作。”
望着罗德手中散发着淡淡光尘的长剑，梅斯不由的赞叹道。
“请恕我直言，罗德先生，我经营商会这么多年，还从来没有见到过如此美丽的武器………”
说道这里，梅斯眯起两只小眼睛。
“不知道，您………”
罗德摆了摆手，却并不是要回答梅斯的问题，他只是盯视着前方，随后沉声回答道。
“我们快到了。”
“哎？”
听到这句话，梅斯和莉洁都急忙抬起头来，顺着罗德的目光向前望去，很快，他们就看见一片杂草丛生的广场，而在广场的另外一侧，两扇破烂的巨大木门正在迷雾的笼罩下忽隐忽现。
“只要穿过这扇门，我们就可以到达阿拉加克山口，然后就能够下山。”
说道这里，罗德也松了口气，毕竟自从他在这个世界苏醒到现在，精神一直都处于高度紧张状态，虽然冒险对于玩家来说是件很快乐的事情，但是如果是在身受重伤，而且充满压力的情况下，那么就算是玩家也不会那么高兴。
更何况这可不是游戏，中途无法下线去抽烟喝酒打麻将的。
但是在那之前，还有一道难关要通过。

罗德皱起眉头，仔细的观察眼前的浓雾。他摆了摆手，示意身后的两人小心注意。
“有什么问题吗？罗德先生？”
看见罗德的手势，莉洁很快就反应过来，她小步靠近了罗德，随后低声询问道。
“小心，战斗还没有结束，我们还有个最麻烦的BOSS没搞定。”
“波丝？”
“呃……我是指怪物。”
罗德摇了摇头，他实在是已经习惯游戏中发号施令的习惯，一时间还真的改不过来。不过现在显然不是注意这种小事的时候，他深深吸了口气，接着转过头去，望向两人。
“你们知道迷雾废墟的由来么？”
听到罗德的询问，两人都是一愣，随后摇了摇头。
“这里曾经是个繁华的小镇，但是在风潮航道开通之后，这里就渐渐变的荒无人烟——在那之后，有一个法师来到了这里，他为了寻回死去的爱人，在这里进行着禁忌的魔法实验，最终，他失败了。”
说道这里，罗德停了一停，随后望向周边被迷雾笼罩的小镇。
“而在那之后，这个小镇就变成了这个样子。”
“那么罗德先生，你说的怪物是………”
梅斯皱了皱眉，他还以为之前那两个石像鬼已经是最可怕的怪物了，难道还有比那个更可怕的？
“幽影。”
从罗德口中说出的这个词平淡无奇，但是那诡异的语调却是让两人都不由的背后一寒。
“它是那个法师在最后的失败中诞生的，最可怕的怪物，如果不小心的话，那么我们所有人都会死在这里。”
“它的战斗力很强吗？罗德先生？”
虽然很疑惑罗德是怎么知道的，但是对于莉洁而言，眼前的问题显然更加重要。但出乎意料之外的是，罗德却摇了摇头。
“坦白来说，算不上很强，它对物理属性的攻击防御很弱，和普通的幽鬼差不多。”

“那…………”
听到罗德的解释，莉洁有些迷惑了，如果说都差不多的话，那么为什么罗德会说这个东西很危险呢？
“因为幽影有一个特殊技能。”
罗德犹豫了下，最终还是决定说出来。
“它会刺探你的内心，然后幻化成你很熟悉的模样，如果你没有办法及时从它制造的恶梦中清醒过来，并且保持坚定信念的话，那么就只有死路一条了。”
说道这里时，罗德的语气并不是非常肯定。因为在游戏里，这个BOSS会在冒险团队全部入场之后才会出现，它会幻化成玩家的样子，然后搅乱玩家的判断，一开始的时候，这的确是个非常麻烦的BOSS，不少团队都团灭在这里。但是办法都是人想出来的，很快玩家就找出了对付它的办法。在多次战斗之后，玩家发现幽鬼的实力并不算强，而且它除了复制玩家本身之外并没有什么特别危险的地方，也就是说，如果只有一个玩家进场的话，那么它就只能够复制对方本身而已，这样一对一的战斗对于大部分玩家来说当然不在话下。于是，在幽鬼的神秘光环被破除之后，它就变成了很多玩家用来练习单刷BOSS的木桩……其下场不可说不悲剧。
但是…………
究竟是为什么，总感觉似乎哪里有些矛盾？
罗德皱了下眉头，他隐隐约约的感觉内心深处有个声音告诉他，事情并没有这么简单，但是一时之间，似乎也抓不住什么头绪。
“总而言之，交给我吧。”
雾气变的越发浓重。
哪怕是充满了神圣力量的光辉，也无法轻而易举的穿透这云雾的海洋。
罗德停下了脚步。
他可以感觉到身后少女担心的目光，但是这却是最有效率的办法，而且，这也是唯一的办法。
“唰！”
白色的利刃凭空出现，云雾似乎因此而燥动了下，随后很快又恢复正常。它们盘旋围绕在罗德的身边，将一切都拒之门外。
空气开始变的潮湿而沉重。
要来了。
罗德提起精神，他下意识的动动手指，戴在食指上的意志之戒所传来的冰凉触感让他的心情平静了许多。他很了解对方，从能力到属性，从它的战斗手段到攻击距离，罗德不认为这有什么困难的………
或许并非如此。

一个人影缓缓的从雾中浮现，伴随着它的出现，周围的空气似乎变的更加躁动不安，流动的雾气折射着那飘乎不定的人影，看起来分外诡异。空气中传来了一阵淡淡的香气，而夹杂其中的，还有一股古怪的气味。
那是消毒水的味道。
罗德皱了皱眉头，他觉得这味道似乎很熟悉，但是，还没有等他再多做考虑。前面的雾气骤然散开，显露出了内里的存在。
而在看到对方的一瞬间，罗德便呆站在了原地。他不敢相信的大睁着双眼，望着眼前的人影，大脑内一片空白，什么也说不出来。被尘封的记忆，在这一瞬间暴发而出，在罗德的内心深处激烈的回荡。

Chapter 20 The Secret of the Mist Ruins
Magical condensation?
Rhodes was really surprised. You have to know that he has been playing Summoned Swordsman for seven years and has seen all kinds of weird situations, but he has never seen such a weird situation.
The so-called magic condensation refers to some summoned elves that have a tacit understanding with the holder and have been used for a long time. During the evolution process, they will "breed" something. According to the game, because they evolve too fast, excessive magic condenses in them, and will eventually transform into magic condensation - in other words, equipment.
However, a simpler way for players to say it is that the summoned spirit that has a high affinity with them will give them a surprise after evolving... and that's it.
But this is not an enviable thing. Firstly, most of the equipment given by the summoned elves are not of high level. Secondly, these equipments are all illusion products and can only be used by the summoner. If they are discarded, they will directly turn into nothingness and cannot be sold or given away, so they are considered useless.
Rhodes was not surprised that the summoned elves produced magic condensation. After all, this holy sword had been with him until now, but what surprised him was--shouldn't the holy sword be equipment?
Generally speaking, only creatures with self-will have the property of magic condensation, right?
What's going on?
The Holy Sword is not a living thing.
However, Rhodes was stunned for only a moment, so the system prompt did not ask him to confirm at all, but just told him that such a thing happened, nothing more. So the golden text quickly dissipated from Rhodes' eyes and disappeared. Then, the card that was originally floating in his hand returned to nothingness.
Li Jie and Metz looked at each other, but neither of them said anything. In fact, they still don't know who Rhodes is or his identity. Although he looks like a swordsman, except for swordsmanship, everything he does can hardly be linked to the profession of swordsman. However, neither of them asked much. As an adventurer, Li Jie naturally knew that many swordsmen had their own unique powers and inheritance. As a result, Metz was even more certain that Rhodes was probably a descendant of an ancient family, and only they could possess such an extraordinary existence.
Although he noticed their gazes, Rhodes did not explain much. As a guild leader, he knew very well that he should speak less and do less unnecessary things. You must know that the war of words between players on the Internet is very exciting and fierce. If you use a wrong word or word, the other party may use it to make use of it. Especially later, Rhodes became the number one guild and became popular. His words and deeds were not used by many enemies. The more you explain, the more loopholes will appear. Just say nothing and let them misunderstand. He just took back the cards and started to sort out other items.
Mages are quite wealthy.
In the church, Li Jie and Metz found not only the statue that controlled the gargoyle, but also a small pile of gems and crystals that had lost their magic power, all of which were left behind by Rhodes. As a part-time alchemist, these things are still of some use to him.
What surprised Rhodes was a diary that Li Jie found on her desk. What was recorded in it was the mage's life after he came to this town.
This made Rhodes interested. Although as a player, he knew the ins and outs of the entire copy of Mist Ruins, but this was the first time he saw it from the perspective of an NPC.
Although most of the contents in the diary have become blurry, some records still remain:
The year of the saint, the fifth day of the thundering month
I succeeded, at the expense of countless innocent livesAfter paying the price, I finally saw her shadow clearly. In the center of the circle, she smiled at me, the same gentle smile as when she was alive. I was so excited that I couldn't help myself. I called her name, but she couldn't hear my response. The spell isn't quite there, but I already have hope that my idea is right!
The year of the saint, the fifteenth day of the thundering month
Praise the holy soul! I finally got her again, and I gained enough power to resist all things! Bringing that dead soul back to me, she saw me! I could touch her, feel her warm body, she hugged me and softly called my name. At that moment, I felt that everything I did was worth it. Ah...my favorite Xina, she is still as gentle, beautiful, and considerate as when she was alive.
I was conflicted, but I finally made up my mind to confess to her. I told her what I had done, but Sheena forgave me. As before, she smiled and forgave me. At that moment, I felt that life was so beautiful, even the sunshine outside was so bright. I have decided that I will take her out of here, and we will live a normal life, a life like ordinary people. I will no longer be exposed to these evil spells, nor will I use spells. We will move to a quiet mountain village, get married there, have children, and then die like ordinary people.
I don’t know if I am still qualified to get such happiness, but I will work hard for it. May the holy soul protect me.
Year of the Saint, Third Day of the Profane Month
Something is wrong.
That wasn't Sheena, I felt that way, even though she looked exactly the same as I remembered. That wasn't her, I told her my plan, but she just smiled and said yes, agreed. It's so weird, she's a smart girl, but she's also an independent girl. She can't listen to everything I say.
I have some doubts. Is there something wrong with the spell?
Why does she believe my words so firmly?
I'm going to do another experiment to confirm whether my idea is correct. Holy Spirit bless me, I hope my idea is wrong.
Year of the Saint, fourth day of the profane month
Holy Spirit, why would such a thing happen?
That's not Sheena! She's just a monster in Sheena's shell! I told her that I would kill old people, children, and women for her. I don't just need her as a woman, I want more women by my side. If this was really her, she would never agree. However, what surprised me was that she just sat quietly by the bed, smiled and listened to what I had to say, and then said yes to me gently.

Year of the Saint, ninth day of the profane month
May the Holy Spirit forgive my ignorance.
This may be my punishment for violating the holy law. I want to reverse life and death and regain my lost soul. But I failed, and this was the punishment. That thing is not Sheena, it has no self at all, it is just an empty body, a monster that reflects instinct and explores the spiritual images deep in other people's hearts to survive. After writing this in the diary, all that is left is a blank space. Rhodes closed the diary and shook his head. It seemed that this mage was indeed a love saint as the rumors said......But if he had chosen to commit suicide earlier, it is estimated that so many people would not have died. But…………
A slight sense of incongruity flashed through Rhodes' mind, and it was gone before he could catch it.
Something seems wrong?
Rhodes frowned and thought for a long time, but in the end he didn't get the answer. However, he quickly put this matter behind him, closed his eyes, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
This was just a small interlude, and then the three of them rested for a night in this abandoned church, and set off again the next day, walking towards the depths of the fog.
"Uh-huh!"
A dazzling white light flashed by, followed by the ghost's figure that disappeared along with the sound of wailing.
Compared with before, the evolved Star Mark is even more beautiful. The flawless white sword blade is carved with beautiful and exquisite hollow patterns. The originally closed snow-white wings are slightly unfolded, and the white silver threads spiraling out from it turn into a cage and surround the sword hilt. Just by looking at it, you will not think that it is a weapon, but a beautiful work of art. It should not appear on the battlefield, but a place like an art gallery or a treasure room is where it truly belongs.
"It's a truly amazing masterpiece."
Looking at the long sword in Rhodes' hand that exuded a faint light, Mace couldn't help but admired it.
"Please forgive me, Mr. Rhodes, I have been running the Chamber of Commerce for so many years, and I have never seen such a beautiful weapon..."
After saying this, Mace narrowed his eyes.
"I don't know, you..."
Rhodes waved his hand, but he didn't want to answer Metz's question. He just stared ahead and answered in a deep voice.
"We're almost there."
"Huh?"
Hearing these words, Mace and Li Jie both raised their heads in a hurry and followed Rhodes' gaze. Soon, they saw a square overgrown with weeds, and on the other side of the square, two huge broken wooden doors were flickering under the fog.
"Just through this gate we can reach Aragak Pass and then descend."
Having said this, Rhodes also breathed a sigh of relief. After all, since he woke up in this world, his spirit has been in a state of high tension. Although taking risks is a very happy thing for players, if they are seriously injured and full of pressure, then even players will not be so happy.
What's more, this is not a game. You can't log off in the middle to smoke, drink, and play mahjong.
But before that, there is still a hurdle to pass.
Rhodes frowned and carefully observed the thick fog in front of him. He waved his hand, signaling the two people behind him to pay careful attention.
"What's the problem? Mr. Rhodes?"
Seeing Rhodes' gesture, Li Jie quickly reacted. She approached Rhodes in small steps, and then asked in a low voice.
"Be careful, the battle is not over yet, we still have the most troublesome BOSS to deal with."
"Pers?"
"Uh... I mean monster."
Rhodes shook his head. He was really used to the habit of giving orders in the game, and he really couldn't change it for a while. But now was obviously not the time to pay attention to such trivial matters. He took a deep breath, then turned his head and looked at the two of them.
"Do you know the origin of the misty ruins?"
Upon hearing Rhodes' question, both of them were stunned, and then shook their heads.
"This used to be a prosperous town, but after the opening of the Fengtide Channel, it gradually became deserted. After that, a mage came here. In order to find his dead lover, he conducted forbidden magic experiments here. In the end, he failed."
After saying this, Rhodes paused for a moment, then looked at the surrounding town shrouded in fog.
"And after that, this is what the town became."
"Then Mr. Rhodes, the monster you are talking about is..."
Mace frowned., he thought that the two gargoyles before were already the most terrifying monsters. Is there anything more terrifying than that?
"Shadow."
The word coming from Rhodes' mouth was unremarkable, but the strange tone made both of them shiver in the back.
"It was born from the final failure of the mage. It is the most terrifying monster. If we are not careful, all of us will die here."
"Is it very powerful in combat? Mr. Rhodes?"
Although I was confused about how Rhodes knew this, for Li Jie, the issue at hand was obviously more important. But unexpectedly, Rhodes shook his head.
"Frankly speaking, it is not very strong. Its physical attack and defense are very weak, almost the same as an ordinary ghost."
"Then..."
Hearing Rhodes' explanation, Li Jie was a little confused. If it was almost the same, then why would Rhodes say that this thing was dangerous?
"Because Shadow has a special skill."
Rhodes hesitated and finally decided to speak out.
"It will poke into your heart and then transform into something you are very familiar with. If you cannot wake up from the nightmare it creates in time and maintain firm belief, then there will be only a dead end."
When Rhodes said this, his tone was not very sure. Because in the game, this BOSS will only appear after all the adventure teams have entered. It will transform into the player's appearance, and then confuse the player's judgment. At the beginning, this was indeed a very troublesome BOSS, and many teams were killed here. But the methods were all thought up by people, and soon players found ways to deal with it. After many battles, the player discovered that the ghost is not very powerful, and there is nothing particularly dangerous about it other than copying the player itself. In other words, if only one player enters the field, then it can only copy the opponent itself. Such a one-on-one battle is of course not a problem for most players. Therefore, after the mysterious aura of the ghost was broken, it became a wooden stake used by many players to practice single-playing the BOSS... The end was tragic.
But…………
Why do you always feel like there is some contradiction somewhere?
Rhodes frowned. He vaguely felt that there was a voice deep in his heart telling him that the matter was not that simple, but for a while, he seemed to have no clue.
"Anyway, leave it to me."
The fog became thicker and thicker.
Even the radiance filled with divine power cannot easily penetrate this ocean of clouds and mist.
Rhodes stopped.
He could feel the worried eyes of the girl behind him, but this was the most efficient way, and it was also the only way.
"Uh-huh!"
A white sharp blade appeared out of thin air, and the clouds seemed to stir for a moment, and then quickly returned to normal. They circled around Rhodes, keeping everything out.
The air became humid and heavy.
Coming.
Rhodes raised his spirits and moved his fingers subconsciously. The cold touch from the Ring of Will on his index finger made him feel much calmer. He knows the opponent very well, from its abilities to attributes, from its combat methods to its attack range. Rhodes doesn't think there is anything difficult about it...
Maybe not.
A figure slowly emerged from the fog. With its appearance, the surrounding air seemed to become more restless. The flowing fog reflected the erratic figure, making it look particularly strange. There was a faint aroma in the air, and mixed with it was a strange smell.
That's the smell of disinfectant.
Rhodes frowned. He felt that the smell seemed familiar, but he didn't think about it further. The fog in front suddenly dispersed, revealinginner presence.
The moment he saw the other party, Rhodes stood there blankly. He opened his eyes wide in disbelief and looked at the figure in front of him. His mind went blank and he couldn't say anything. The dust-laden memories burst out at this moment, echoing fiercely deep in Rhodes' heart.
